items.remarks: Plant aux load SRC-NG-100 10.30 MW (AL-01..22 excl. GSU losses AL-08/09), LDO case about 10.9 MW, MAX case 9.70 MW; design MV bus load 11.1 MW incl. AL-21 losses = 12.6 MVA at pf 0.88, +10 % = 13.9 MVA (765 A at 10.5 kV). items.service: ST unit auxiliary transformer 15.75/10.5 kV (ST generator terminals to MV section B)
items.remarks: Plant aux load SRC-NG-100 10.30 MW (AL-01..22 excl. GSU losses AL-08/09), LDO case about 10.9 MW, MAX case 9.70 MW; design MV bus load 11.1 MW incl. AL-21 losses = 12.6 MVA at pf 0.88, +10 % = 13.9 MVA (765 A at 10.5 kV). 16 MVA = 115 % of design load; CW pump start (2 MW x 6 = 14 MVA) with one UAT out: bus Ssc 160 MVA (uk 10 %) gives dip about 9 %, acceptable; uk 10 % = 8.8 kA at 10.5 kV.

findings: Auxiliary load (SRC-NG-100 AL-01..22): 10.30 MW excl. transformer losses, 10.54 MW incl. AL-21; LDO case about 10.9 MW, MAX 9.70 MW. MV design load 12.6 MVA (13.9 MVA with 10 %) - each UAT (2 x 100 %) must carry it: 16 MVA (20BBT) is acceptable but only 115 % loaded; 31.5 MVA (10BBT) is 2.3 x load and is justified only if the GT static starter (about 9 MW, missing in aux_load and equipment list) is fed from it.

LV transformers 00BFT10/20 (2 x 2.5 MVA, 'A/B') cannot be 2 x 100 %: LV load on main boards about 4.7 MW (5.3 MVA); would need about 4-5 MVA each or the concept is 2 x 50 % with load shedding. 00BFT30/40 are single units with no redundancy (1.6 MVA for 0.3-0.6 MW load, oversized).

Non-standard motor sizes outside my systems: CW pumps 1,900 kW (aux 1,939 kW input = 1,860 kW shaft -> 2,000 kW) and BFPs 3,600 kW (3,089 kW input; 3,550 or 4,000 kW standard). CW pump DOL start needs the 2,000 kW value for the MV short-circuit / start check.

GT static starting frequency converter (SFC, about 8-10 MW) and its transformer/switchgear are not in equipment or aux_load; it drives the UAT and MV sizing during start (10BBT out: 20BBT 16 MVA would carry SFC + start-up aux about 15 MVA).
00SAA10 parent rated_power 450 kW duplicates the three chillers (3 x 150); avoid double count. HVAC installed 700 kW, running about 530 kW + lighting about 220 kW = 750 kW (AL-17) - consistent.
Single tags for UPS (00BRA10), DC battery (00BTA10) and MV boards represent 2 x 100 % units (two UPS, two batteries/chargers); equipment list should count 2 units or separate tags.
Fire detection/alarm panels (MR-IC-006) and the GT/ST turbine control are not in my systems; emergency loads rely on them being on UPS 00BRA10 (included in the 100 kVA).

MV consumer count is 9 (system quantities): both CW pumps, BFPs, CEPs, SWRO HP pumps and a 250 kW electric fire pump (00SGA10AP001) - fire pump on MV is unusual and would normally be LV or diesel driven.
